SnippetLibrary__Meta.SnippetLibrary__Description: Reusable blocks of prompt text that get bolted onto many different prompts - geometry lock clauses, negative constraint lists, material schedules and house style statements. Snippets can be copied on their own or inserted into a prompt while editing it.

SnippetLibrary__Schema__Template.Snippet__Description: What this block does and when to bolt it on.
Snippet__Text: Snippet body stored as an array of lines, same convention as the prompt records.
Double brace tokens are allowed here too and are picked up when the snippet is inserted into a prompt.

BuildingMaterials__ScheduleBlock.Snippet__Description: Standard heading and variable slot for the per job material specification. Drop this at the foot of any image prompt that needs real materials.

GeometryLock__PreserveExactly.Snippet__Description: Hard constraint clause that stops a model redesigning the building. Use on every whitecard conversion.
Snippet__Text: Treat the input image as fixed source geometry: preserve the building design, massing, dimensions, proportions, roof forms, openings, architectural details, landscaping, camera position, perspective, composition and crop exactly. Trace and enhance the existing model; do not reinterpret, redesign, simplify or add anything.

NegativeConstraints__ArchitecturalInkDra.Snippet__Description: The proven exclusion list for high-key monochrome line work output.
Snippet__Text: No colour, beige paper, watercolour, photorealistic materials, dramatic lighting, heavy shadows, ambient-occlusion render, thick outlines, loose sketch marks, smudging, painterly texture, cartoon styling, blueprint graphics, people, vehicles, text or additional architecture. Preserve the original image exactly; change only its graphic rendering style.

PhotographyBrief__DslrArchitectural.Snippet__Description: Camera and quality framing that pushes output towards a professionally shot architectural photograph rather than a render.
Snippet__Text: The result must be indistinguishable from a high-quality DSLR photograph taken by a professional architecture photographer. Natural optics, correct vertical perspective, no lens distortion, no HDR halos and no over-sharpening.

NoInvention__DoNotAddDetail.Snippet__Title: No Invention - Do Not Add Detail
NoInvention__DoNotAddDetail.Snippet__Description: Blunt one-liner that stops models embellishing a scheme with details that were never designed.
Snippet__Text: Do not make up any new details. You must render this exact shot. You are not adding any new details to the building.
